status: Authored proofs with exact supplementary checks

applications.supplier: J. von Buhren, JTNB 29 (2017), 307–320, Theorem 1.1, printed p. 308
applications.constructed_objects: Integral graph closure over P1_r times P1_S, a fixed product of the j=1728 elliptic curve, and a fixed finite-rank group including the required torsion.
checks: Every zero-index torsion choice is frozen before applying the theorem; finitely many choices are covered.
All evaluated weights are positive; pole coefficients cannot cancel on an abelian translate through an actual point.
The two conjugate generators are independent over Z[i] modulo torsion.
O(3O) and the Segre embedding satisfy condition (1.1) for every positive degree.
The group is fixed before the parameter; its points lie in C(Gamma,epsilon) with zero error.
The canonical height controls every retained index, including the doubled half-integral third index.
applications.limitation: The additive constant is ineffective. This is an authored source-application proof, not independent non-author acceptance.

applications.supplier: Manvir Jaswal, Hexagon 2611.00331v2, 12 November 2026, Theorem 1.2, printed p. 4
checks: Prepared b satisfies 0<b<1, square reduced denominator, and the required 2-adic squareclass and depth.
The positive squarefree representatives beta and theta are coprime, both 1 modulo 8, and have the required mutual quadratic-residue conditions.
The beta=1 case is supplied separately without applying a theorem requiring beta>1.
The actual two points have abscissas in beta times rational squares, and the second curve is scaled explicitly.
The displayed rational changes of coordinates give both pole equations, with their required nonzero quantities.
No sharing of arbitrary distinct squareclasses is asserted.
applications.limitation: This uses precisely the cited preprint theorem as an explicit arithmetic supplier. It is not a complete audit of the preprint or a claim of peer review.

applications.supplier: Complete fixed-difference chart in the retained source and corrected v27 five-coordinate chart
checks: The omitted f*S coefficient in the earlier printed v26 L is restored.
Five exact ideal-membership identities and two forward identities are checked.
The exceptional M=0 case has no K-rational solution, as proved by the quintic factorization and nonsquare discriminant.
Every rational point of the old chart uniquely reconstructs the new weight, and conversely.
Applications to the 79-, 224-, and 260-variable tables are reconstructed independently; no coordinate is dropped solely on a generic subset.
applications.limitation: Independent implementation is separate from independent non-author review; the latter is not claimed.
